verdict.rationale: Homebrew supports bulk operations in several documented ways. `brew bundle` installs a whole set of formulae, casks, taps and other package types declared in a Brewfile, and `brew bundle dump` snapshots everything installed. `brew untap` accepts multiple taps, and autoremove cleans up all orphaned dependencies at once. Community reports confirm that `brew upgrade` updates many packages in one run, though some users find that overly eager. Missing for 10: explicit docs on multi-argument install/uninstall/upgrade semantics, selective or filtered bulk targeting (e.g. pin/exclude sets), and documented machine-readable output or per-item results for agent-driven bulk runs.
